description: Get NMLP's canonical business entity card — address, phone, services, area served, languages, and the 24/7 drop box (dropBox): a covered, waterproof box outside the gate, near the road, at 5445 Edith Blvd NE (Unit A is only the business address) that takes books and all media in any condition plus clean, wearable clothing. Someone is at the warehouse 8 a.m.-3 p.m. daily to help unload; if the box is full or a load is too big, text 505-250-3804 or come in that window, and never leave items beside the box. Calls are answered in English; Spanish speakers text for a written reply in Spanish.
name: nmlp_get_business_card
